_comment: Security-debt ratchet for the E2E suite.
`baseline` is the number of cases carrying a `known-vulnerability` annotation — each one
asserts the SECURE expectation and is wrapped in test.fail() (or annotated where the control
is infrastructural). scripts/generate-e2e-report.js fails CI when the live count EXCEEDS this
number, so a new vulnerability cannot land silently.
Enforced only when E2E_ENFORCE_RATCHET=1, which the CI report job sets after merging every
shard. A partial run sees a fraction of the total, so comparing it would be meaningless.
Lowering the baseline is always welcome and should happen in the same PR as the fix.
Raising it needs a justification in the commit message.

SEC-17.finding: M-2 — no script-src CSP on the frontend. The only CSP set is frame-ancestors, which does nothing against XSS.
SEC-17.impact: Combined with H-1 (bypassable sanitizer) and M-3 (tokens in localStorage), a surviving payload can exfiltrate an admin session.
SEC-17.retiredBy: Add a real script-src/default-src policy in frontend/next.config.mjs headers().

SEC-21.finding: M-3 — access and refresh tokens are stored in localStorage, readable by any script on the page.
SEC-21.impact: Turns any XSS from defacement into full account takeover.
SEC-21.retiredBy: Move the session to httpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies in shared/lib/api.ts + the auth controller.

SEC-25.finding: Rate limits key on X-Forwarded-For via the hardcoded `trust proxy: 1`.
SEC-25.impact: CORRECT on Render/Railway, whose edges append the real client IP as the rightmost entry — which is what proxy-addr resolves req.ip to, so a spoofed header is ignored there. Exposed only where the hop count differs from 1: the self-host path if :4000 stays publicly reachable or the reverse proxy replaces rather than appends the header, and any future CDN in front (2 hops vs the hardcoded 1).
SEC-25.note: Annotated but NOT test.fail() — this suite depends on the no-proxy behaviour for per-worker parallelism, and the control is infrastructural. An earlier version of this entry overstated the risk as a straightforward bypass on Render; that was wrong.
SEC-25.retiredBy: Make the hop count environment-driven rather than hardcoded in main.ts:16, firewall :4000 on the self-host path, and key the login throttle on email+IP so credential stuffing cannot be spread across rotated IPs at all.

VDETAIL-A-01.finding: A11Y — the gallery lightbox declares aria-modal="true" without trapping focus.
VDETAIL-A-01.impact: Tab escapes to the page behind the dialog (WCAG 2.4.3), which is exactly the confusion aria-modal is meant to prevent.

A11Y-A-16.finding: A11Y — the departments edit modal declares aria-modal="true" without trapping focus.
A11Y-A-16.impact: Same as VDETAIL-A-01. Arguably introduced by adding the role without the behaviour it promises.
